description: Config #11: the shared baseline (--conditions "Prompt" --prompt-variant standard) re-run over the 15-maze conditional set with FULL thinking on all three models, to isolate the value of reasoning depth vs the thinking-low/off experimental sweep. Opus runs adaptive+effort:xhigh; paid max_tokens raised to 8192 (M6 exception).
_allow_unequal_max_tokens_note: As-run archive: 4096/8192/16384 caps. This CONFOUNDS the cross-model thinking comparison (FINDINGS §4) — a clean re-run needs one equal, large cap (>=16384) for all three models.
